items.title: Marian McPartland — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Elvis was . . . he had taken over. ... when you started hearing about . . . even Elvis Presley ... How did that really . . . did you notice a shift in terms of the focus in live music and studio.

ctx.x: That would certainly be traumatizing enough to do that [laughs].
Well it was. That can maybe give you an idea of the date. Elvis was . . . he had taken over.
